The '''Ackbar Slash''' was a [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]] tactical maneuver<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> devised by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]].<ref name="WS" /> It involved driving a battle line through the center of the enemy formation, a move that was ideally suited to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] due to their multiple [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]]. As the line drove through the enemy formation, the attacking ships delivered broadsides to the enemy on both sides. Return fire from the enemy only came from those ships either side of the attacking line, as ships on the outer edges of the enemy formation were out of optimum firing position.<ref name="RASB" /> There also were instances wherein [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] used the same tactic when outnumbered.<ref name="WS" />

The main disadvantage of the Ackbar Slash was the possibility that the lead vessel in the line could be disabled or destroyed, leading the following ships to break formation to avoid collision. In that instance, the attacking force was at risk of being destroyed by an enemy that had managed to retain its formation and command and control.<ref name="RASB" />

==Behind the scenes==
This tactic bears a striking resemblance to real-world Admiral [[Wikipedia:Horatio Nelson|Horatio Nelson's]] actions at the [[Wikipedia:Battle of Trafalgar|Battle of Trafalgar]].
